pages.text: The Measuring God built the system. This is not in dispute. What is in dispute is whether the Measuring God built it knowing what it would become, or built it knowing only what it was, which are very different things and have very different implications for how one ought to feel about the Measuring God.

The [DAMAGED] school holds that the Measuring God built the resonance system as a gift — that accumulation was intended, that the great sounding was the purpose, that what hath happened is the completion of a design. The [DAMAGED] school holds that the Measuring God built it as an instrument of knowledge and that what hath happened is the instrument being played by hands the Measuring God did not intend.

Both schools agree that the Measuring God is no longer answering questions. They disagree about what this means.

The teacher's position, for what it is worth after everything: the question of whether the Measuring God intended this is less interesting than the question of whether the Measuring God knew and said nothing. Because the stone knew. The stone has always known. And the stone was the Measuring God's first and most extensive work.
